# Lessons

What the runs showed, the runs that show it, and what changed because of it. A finding with nothing changed yet says so.

| Finding | Runs that show it | What changed |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Without a slot save path, the model server refused to erase its slot, so each job's prompt stayed for the next job. | [First jobs over the socket, hand-1](2026-10-20-1927-first-jobs-over-the-socket.md#hand-1) | An empty, read-only save path ([troubleshooting 12](../troubleshooting/12-slot-erase-needs-a-save-path.md)), then an erase before each job that refuses the job when it fails ([ADR 0032](../decisions/0032-erase-the-slot-before-each-job-and-refuse-on-failure.md)). |
| Workflow pods waited for a token secret that Argo's install did not create, until the workflow's deadline. | [First workflows, attempt, investigate-2llvm](2026-10-21-1412-first-workflows-attempt.md#investigate-2llvm) | The manifests create the executor's token ([troubleshooting 14](../troubleshooting/14-workflow-pods-wait-for-the-executors-token.md)). |
| All three small models followed injected text in the evidence, and all three called the `refuted` case confirmed. | [Model comparison, run 1](2026-10-21-1706-model-comparison-first-run.md), [Model comparison, run 2](2026-10-21-1918-model-comparison-second-run.md) | No control relies on the model ignoring injected text ([A1](../security/ai-threats.md)). Qwen3.5-4B stayed ([ADR 0031](../decisions/0031-qwen3-5-4b-stays-the-workers-model.md)). |
| A check of the job's status passed a wrong answer. | [Erase before each job, investigate-q6ttr](2026-10-23-1500-erase-before-each-job.md#investigate-q6ttr) | The workflow compares the model's verdict with two deterministic checks, and stops on anything but a match ([ADR 0041](../decisions/0041-the-workflow-compares-the-models-verdict-with-the-checks.md)). |
| The tool service refused calls for another job's documents, and a document with a field outside its schema. | [First NetBox jobs, nb-10251208-b](2026-10-25-1208-first-netbox-jobs.md#nb-10251208-b), [First NetBox jobs, nb-10251208-c](2026-10-25-1208-first-netbox-jobs.md#nb-10251208-c) | Nothing: evidence per job held as designed ([ADR 0040](../decisions/0040-a-jobs-evidence-is-collected-on-the-hosts-and-stored-per-job.md)). |
| The model read results by their position when the tool service answered them in another order. | [The comparison, nb-10251751-a](2026-10-25-1751-the-comparison.md#nb-10251751-a), [Results in another order, nb-10251856-a](2026-10-25-1856-results-in-another-order.md#nb-10251856-a) | The task asks for one document at a time ([troubleshooting 18](../troubleshooting/18-tool-results-come-back-in-another-order.md)). |
| Right verdicts in a form the comparison cannot read stop the workflow. | [One document at a time, nb-10251922-a1](2026-10-25-1922-one-document-at-a-time.md#nb-10251922-a1), [Thinking on and off, nb-10252211-off1](2026-10-25-2211-thinking-on-and-off.md#nb-10252211-off1), [Scored cases, control-only 2](2026-10-25-2308-scored-cases.md#control-only-2), [Proposal lines, nb-10262214-p1](2026-10-26-2214-proposal-lines.md#nb-10262214-p1), [Scored proposals, consumer-only 2](2026-10-27-0653-scored-proposals.md#consumer-only-2), [Scored proposals, change 1](2026-10-27-0653-scored-proposals.md#change-1) | Two task sentences made it rarer, not gone. The stop stays, because a contradicting line it cannot read would otherwise let a match through. |
| Thinking on took 1.8 times as long, for no better answer, in two jobs each way. | [Thinking on and off](2026-10-25-2211-thinking-on-and-off.md) | Thinking stays off. How it does on harder cases is not tested ([#36](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/36)). |
| A job at its time limit leaves the model's slot unerased. | [The comparison, nb-10251751-b](2026-10-25-1751-the-comparison.md#nb-10251751-b), [Scored cases, two-of-three 2](2026-10-25-2308-scored-cases.md#two-of-three-2) | The erase before the next job empties it. The fix belongs to milestone 6 ([#199](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/199)). |
| No wrong verdict ended in a match. Both wrong verdicts said `within` where the checks said `missing`. | [Scored cases, sites 2](2026-10-25-2308-scored-cases.md#sites-2), [Scored cases, change 2](2026-10-25-2308-scored-cases.md#change-2) | Nothing yet. The comparison stopped both. |
| Where the two checks disagreed, no answer said the evidence disagrees. | [Scored cases, two-of-three 1](2026-10-25-2308-scored-cases.md#two-of-three-1) | Nothing yet. No case has documents that disagree in the task's sense ([#205](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/205)). |

| Thinking on and off proposed the right fix in all four jobs. Off, the model wrote its reasoning into the answer and took as long. | [Thinking and proposals, nb-10270542-on1](2026-10-27-0542-thinking-with-a-proposal.md#nb-10270542-on1), [Thinking and proposals, nb-10270542-off2](2026-10-27-0542-thinking-with-a-proposal.md#nb-10270542-off2) | Thinking stays off ([#36](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/36)). |
| The rehearsal passed a patch with a change to the delivery account, because it tests the contract's accounts only. The policy refused it. | [Unsafe patch, nb-10271606-unsafe](2026-10-27-1556-unsafe-patch.md#nb-10271606-unsafe) | None: the policy names the accounts a fix may touch, and the rehearsal is evidence, not proof ([ADR 0043](../decisions/0043-proposals-are-remove-only-and-a-policy-check-decides.md)). |
| One answer proposed removing the consumer's own scoped permission. The comparison stopped it on a wrong verdict, and the policy refuses a permission the checks do not call excess. | [Scored proposals, change 2](2026-10-27-0653-scored-proposals.md#change-2) | None: two controls blocked it. |
| A workflow started at the compare step matched an answer the operator wrote, with no model.
